concerns.text: T060 requires prs_labeled.csv to carry the FULL pr_schema columns (comment_count, time_to_merge_minutes, review_cycles, complexity_score, loc, hour_of_day, day_of_week), but those values are only computed downstream by T061/T062, which read prs_labeled.csv as INPUT. As written, T060 cannot produce a schema-valid file, and T061/T062 would violate Data Hygiene (Principle III: no in-place modification; derivations must write NEW files) if they 'complete' the same CSV. Either T060 writes label-only columns to a distinct file, or T062's prs_metrics.csv must be the schema-conformant artifact and prs_labeled.csv scoped to labels.

T060 redefines confidence_score as 'a weighted combination of signature strength and detector score, signature weighted higher'. FR-002 defines confidence as SIGNATURE-match confidence with the 0.6 flagging threshold tied to signature ambiguity ('If the signature match confidence is < 0.6 ... label the PR as human and flag it'). Blending in the detector score silently changes the semantics of the 0.6 threshold and the flagged_for_audit population defined in the spec's edge cases. This is a semantic weakening the deterministic FR-012 check cannot catch.

T063 requires results.json to 'conform to statistical_result.schema.yaml' while also including effect-size interpretation and sensitivity-comparison sections, and T065 further extends it with complexity_correlation and gate status. The schema has additionalProperties: false and requires u_statistic/p_value_u/effect_size_u as primary fields. The aggregated results.json as specified will fail its own declared schema validation; the task list silently relaxes the contract it cites.

Principle VI mandates 'processing pull request metadata in batches of 50 PRs' and a watchdog that terminates/pauses if the 6-hour job limit is approached. No task specifies the 50-PR batch size (T007/T013 say only 'batch processing'), and no remaining task implements the runtime watchdog promised in plan.md Constitution Check §6. Both constitutional constraints lack implementing, verifiable tasks.

T062 excludes unmerged PRs from time_to_merge_minutes. FR-003 says metrics MUST be calculated 'for every PR in the dataset', and pr_schema.schema.yaml sets time_to_merge_minutes minimum 0 with no nullable option. Excluding rows is a defensible analytic choice but is a silent narrowing of FR-003 and will also break T061's verification ('one row per PR in prs_labeled.csv') unless the exclusion is propagated consistently. Make the exclusion explicit in the spec/contract or handle unmerged PRs per the schema.

T063 makes t-tests primary (matching spec FR-004) with a documented deviation doc, but plan.md and statistical_result.schema.yaml still designate Mann-Whitney U as primary. The tasks document cannot unilaterally resolve a spec/plan/schema contradiction; the deviation is documented, but the schema's required-fields ordering (u_statistic primary, t_statistic 'Sensitivity only') still contradicts T063's output. Align the authoritative ordering across artifacts.

T064 writes audit artifacts to data/audit/ (audit_log.jsonl, manual_audit_results.json, error_rate.json) while data-model.md specifies data/processed/audit_log.csv with the AuditSample entity (predicted_label, human_ground_truth, correct, notes). The audit output contract is silently changed by the task; either update the data model or conform the task's artifact paths/fields.
